metadata.question: Was there a noticeable larger bloom (represented by a brighter blue color) in Hood Canal in late August 2022, compared to August 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-2 (good for detecting water color/algae blooms via true color and chlorophyll indices) - Date: August 2021 vs. late August 2022 - Location: Hood Canal, Washington State (approximately 47.8°N, -122.8°W) - I'll use median composites for each period to get cloud-free imagery 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud mask Sentinel-2 using QA60 band (bit 10=clouds, bit 11=cirrus) - The question asks about "brighter blue color" which could indicate algae bloom; I'll calculate a chlorophyll proxy (NDCI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red)) or use true color RGB visualization metrics - Alternatively, use a simple blue/cyan brightness indicator via B2 (blue band) intensity 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - If no images found → C1 - If pixel count = 0 after masking → C2 - If NDCI or blue band values are valid numbers → compare 2022 vs 2021 - If values are None/NaN → C3 - If 2022 shows noticeably brighter/higher values than 2021 → A - Otherwise → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Hood Canal geometry (bounding box) const hoodCanal = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-122.95, 47.65, -122.65, 47.95]); // Function to mask clouds in Sentinel-2 function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // August 2021 collection const col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(hoodCanal) .filterDate('2021-08-01', '2021-08-31') .map(maskClouds) .select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4', 'B8']); // Late August 2022 collection const col2022 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(hoodCanal) .filterDate('2022-08-15', '2022-08-31') .map(maskClouds) .select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4', 'B8']); const size2021 = col2021.size().getInfo(); const size2022 = col2022.size().getInfo(); print(`Aug 2021 Images: ${size2021}, Aug 2022 Images: ${size2022}`); if (size2021 === 0 || size2022 === 0) { print("C1: Empty Collection - No images found for one or both periods."); return; } // Create median composites const median2021 = col2021.median(); const median2022 = col2022.median(); // Calculate NDCI (Normalized Difference Chlorophyll Index) = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) // Higher values suggest algae/bloom presence const ndci2021 = median2021.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDCI'); const ndci2022 = median2022.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDCI'); // Also track blue band (B2) as brightness indicator const blue2021 = median2021.select('B2'); const blue2022 = median2022.select('B2'); // Reduce to get statistics const stats2021_ndci = ndci2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hoodCanal, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2022_ndci = ndci2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hoodCanal, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2021_blue = blue2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hoodCanal, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2022_blue = blue2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hoodCanal, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); // Get pixel counts to verify valid data const count2021 = ndci2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: hoodCanal, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count2022 = ndci2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: hoodCanal, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const validPixels2021 = count2021.NDCI || 0; const validPixels2022 = count2022.NDCI || 0; print(`2021 Valid Pixels: ${validPixels2021}, 2022 Valid Pixels: ${validPixels2022}`); if (validPixels2021 === 0 || validPixels2022 === 0) { print("C2: No Valid Pixels - After masking, no valid data remains."); return; } const ndci2021_val = stats2021_ndci.NDCI; const ndci2022_val = stats2022_ndci.NDCI; const blue2021_val = stats2021_blue.B2; const blue2022_val = stats2022_blue.B2; if (ndci2021_val === null || ndci2022_val === null || blue2021_val === null || blue2022_val === null) { print("C3: Calculation Failure - Result is null or invalid."); return; } print(`NDCI 2021: ${ndci2021_val.toFixed(4)}, NDCI 2022: ${ndci2022_val.toFixed(4)}`); print(`Blue 2021: ${blue2021_val.toFixed(0)}, Blue 2022: ${blue2022_val.toFixed(0)}`); // Determine if 2022 bloom was noticeably larger // "Brighter blue" = higher blue band values and potentially higher NDCI (more vegetation/algae) const ndciIncrease = ((ndci2022_val - ndci2021_val) / Math.abs(ndci2021_val + 0.0001)) * 100; const blueIncrease = ((blue2022_val - blue2021_val) / blue2021_val) * 100; print(`NDCI % Change: ${ndciIncrease.toFixed(1)}%, Blue % Change: ${blueIncrease.toFixed(1)}%`); // A noticeable bloom would show higher blue brightness and higher NDCI // Threshold: >10% increase in either metric suggests a notable bloom if (blueIncrease > 10 || ndciIncrease > 15) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
